title: Iran Charts Path to Economic Gains from BRICS Membership
text:
Iran Charts Path to Economic Gains from BRICS Membership"

""
"The Head of International Affairs at the Tehran Chamber of Commerce has stated that the upcoming BRICS summit, which will be attended by the heads of member states, is scheduled to be held in New Delhi next month. For the first time, the Tehran Chamber will send a representative to this summit, with the Chamber’s President also attending the meeting."

"According to an interview with Tasnim, the Chamber aims to bring together major and reputable companies to introduce projects at the summit that have the potential to be implemented through both bilateral and multilateral cooperation with BRICS member countries.
